bookings_requested_range.name: bookings_requested_range
bookings_requested_range.value: "bookings"."requested_ends_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."requested_starts_at" IS NULL OR "bookings"."requested_ends_at" > "bookings"."requested_starts_at"

bookings_cancelled_fields.name: bookings_cancelled_fields
bookings_cancelled_fields.value: "bookings"."status" NOT IN ('cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_business') OR "bookings"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

snow_contracts_season_payment.name: snow_contracts_season_payment
snow_contracts_season_payment.value: ("snow_contracts"."season_price_cents" IS NOT NULL) = ("snow_contracts"."season_payment" IS NOT NULL)

visits_marked_complete_fields.name: visits_marked_complete_fields
visits_marked_complete_fields.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('completed_pending_confirmation', 'disputed', 'fix_scheduled', 'completed') OR "visits"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL

visits_cancelled_fields.name: visits_cancelled_fields
visits_cancelled_fields.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_business') OR "visits"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL

businesses_published_idx.name: businesses_published_idx
businesses_published_idx.where: "businesses"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "businesses"."suspended_at" IS NULL

businesses_booking_notice.name: businesses_booking_notice
businesses_booking_notice.value: "businesses"."min_notice_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND "businesses"."max_days_ahead" BETWEEN 7 AND 180 AND "businesses"."min_notice_days" < "businesses"."max_days_ahead"

services_price_matches_pricing_type.name: services_price_matches_pricing_type
services_price_matches_pricing_type.value: ("services"."pricing_type" = 'fixed' AND "services"."price_cents" IS NOT NULL) OR ("services"."pricing_type" = 'quote' AND "services"."price_cents" IS NULL)

community_fund_ledger_amount_sign.name: community_fund_ledger_amount_sign
community_fund_ledger_amount_sign.value:
CASE "community_fund_ledger"."kind" WHEN 'donation' THEN "community_fund_ledger"."amount_cents" > 0
        WHEN 'adjustment' THEN "community_fund_ledger"."amount_cents" <> 0
        ELSE "community_fund_ledger"."amount_cents" < 0 END

community_fund_ledger_links.name: community_fund_ledger_links
community_fund_ledger_links.value:
CASE WHEN "community_fund_ledger"."kind" IN ('donation', 'fee', 'refund')
          THEN "community_fund_ledger"."donation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_fund_ledger"."referral_id" IS NULL
        WHEN "community_fund_ledger"."kind" = 'payout'
          THEN "community_fund_ledger"."referral_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_fund_ledger"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "community_fund_ledger"."donation_id" IS NULL
        ELSE true END

community_fund_ledger_adjustment_memo.name: community_fund_ledger_adjustment_memo
community_fund_ledger_adjustment_memo.value: "community_fund_ledger"."kind" <> 'adjustment' OR ("community_fund_ledger"."memo" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("community_fund_ledger"."memo") <> '')

community_referrals_booking.name: community_referrals_booking
community_referrals_booking.value:
CASE WHEN "community_referrals"."status" IN ('booked', 'completed') THEN "community_referrals"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN "community_referrals"."status" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'declined') THEN "community_referrals"."booking_id" IS NULL
        ELSE true END

donations_payment_has_booking.name: donations_payment_has_booking
donations_payment_has_booking.value: "donations"."payment_id" IS NULL OR "donations"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL

donations_status_fields.name: donations_status_fields
donations_status_fields.value: ("donations"."status" = 'pending' OR "donations"."succeeded_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("donations"."status" <> 'refunded' OR "donations"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL)

disputes_resolved_fields.name: disputes_resolved_fields
disputes_resolved_fields.value: ("disputes"."status" = 'resolved') = ("disputes"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_awaiting_payout_idx.name: payments_awaiting_payout_idx
payments_awaiting_payout_idx.where: "payments"."payout_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."released_at" IS NOT NULL

payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx.name: payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx
payments_one_live_per_visit_uidx.where: "payments"."visit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled')

payments_one_live_per_booking_uidx.name: payments_one_live_per_booking_uidx
payments_one_live_per_booking_uidx.where: "payments"."visit_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."period_id" IS NULL AND "payments"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled')

payments_one_live_per_period_uidx.name: payments_one_live_per_period_uidx
payments_one_live_per_period_uidx.where: "payments"."period_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'cancelled')

quotes_recurring_terms.name: quotes_recurring_terms
quotes_recurring_terms.value:
CASE WHEN "quotes"."kind" = 'recurring'
        THEN cardinality("quotes"."frequencies") > 0 AND "quotes"."duration_minutes" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE cardinality("quotes"."frequencies") = 0 END

quotes_snow_terms.name: quotes_snow_terms
quotes_snow_terms.value:
CASE WHEN "quotes"."kind" = 'snow_contract'
        THEN num_nonnulls("quotes"."price_basis", "quotes"."trigger_cm", "quotes"."season_start", "quotes"."season_end") = 4
          AND "quotes"."trigger_cm" > 0 AND "quotes"."season_end" > "quotes"."season_start"
          AND ("quotes"."price_basis" = 'season') = ("quotes"."season_billing" IS NOT NULL)
        ELSE num_nonnulls("quotes"."price_basis", "quotes"."trigger_cm", "quotes"."season_start", "quotes"."season_end", "quotes"."season_billing") = 0 END
